description_en: Migrates an ApsaraDB for MongoDB instance to another zone
description_zh: 迁移MongoDB实例到其他可用区
kebab_example: aliyun dds migrate-to-other-zone --instance-id dds-bp26580000 --zone-id cn-hangzhou-b --region cn-hangzhou
name: MigrateToOtherZone

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the instance.

If the network type of the instance is VPC, you must specify the Vswitch parameter
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。

如果实例的网络类型为专有网络，您还需要传入VSwitchId参数
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the destination zone to which you want to migrate the ApsaraDB for MongoDB instance.

The destination and source zones must be in one region.

You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/61933.html to query the zone IDs
parameters.help_zh:
迁移的目标可用区ID。

迁移的目标可用区必须和当前实例的可用区处于同一地域。
您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/61933.html接口查询可用区ID
parameters.name: zone_id

parameters.help_en:
The time when the instance is migrated to the destination zone. Valid values:

Immediately (default): The instance is migrated immediately.

MaintainTime: The instance is migrated during its maintenance window
parameters.help_zh:
迁移可用区的生效时间，取值：
Immediately（默认值）：立即生效。
MaintainTime：在实例的可运维时间段内生效
parameters.name: effective_time

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the vSwitch in the destination zone.

This parameter is valid and required only when the network type of the instance is VPC
parameters.help_zh:
迁移的目标可用区虚拟交换机ID。

当实例的网络类型为专有网络时，本参数才可用且必须传入
parameters.name: vswitch_id
